H1.method: prespecified Qwen/LFM centered topic-bootstrap tests with Holm correction
H1.other_models: exploratory C estimates only; no same-data type assignment followed by a confirmatory type test

E4_selection.generalized_fallback: r=6-number_of_available_mandatory; r equally spaced absolute-C quantiles

selection_policy: Mandatory Qwen4/LFM when R0 operational and finite fresh180 C. Remaining r slots use fixed remaining-pool |C| quantiles linspace(0,1,r), without replacement; distance, fewer represented architecture, fewer publisher family, fixed SHA256 tie-break.

E0_protocol_versions.pre_E1_clarification:
2026-10-31 pre-E1 clarification: the model-selection quantile variable is |C|,
as explicitly specified in the proposal E4 paragraph. The earlier unqualified C
wording was a transcription error. No E1 scores had been run or inspected when
this correction was made. Signed C is retained in results and interpretation.

2026-10-31 pre-E1/pre-E4 Monte Carlo allocation clarification: for E4b,
100000 trajectories per design/initial condition/topic/model are stratified over
the fixed20 mappings, 5000 trajectories per mapping. Each mapping has an
independent seed. Within one mapping, all80 designs and measured/P0/PK methods
share random priorities and draws. Report each mapping's means and paired MCSE;
for averages across mappings use the independent-stratum variance sum/20^2.
This is100000 total, not100000 per mapping. Between-mapping variability is
reported separately. Single-round full enumerations remain unchanged. The
allocation is frozen before E1 or E4 outcomes, based on a synthetic CPU timing
benchmark (80designs,1000draws,6rounds,3methods:4.681sec; full100k/map about23.4
CPUdays for the initial6model E4 panel versus1.17days for stratified100k total).
Actual hardware runtime and optional GPU acceleration will be measured separately.

2026-10-31 E0 task-pilot refinement before E1: calibration20 only freezes token
IDs and records diagnostics; it no longer automatically rejects a remedy before
the12-item actual-task pilot. Fixed original/T2/prefill order and formal pilot/
development thresholds remain unchanged. All previously skipped earlier remedies
are revisited symmetrically. See provenance/E0_taskpilot_amendment_20261031.txt;
previous E0 selection snapshots and raw scores remain preserved.

2026-10-31 final pre-E1 conditional option-mass amendment: operational admission
is the union of the earlier q>=.70 / format>=.90 / R2>=.85 branch and a conditional
q>=.50 / format>=.95 / R2>=.90 branch, applied symmetrically to all10 models in
fixed remedy order on actual-task pilot12 and full100. This adaptive development
refinement follows observed E0 quality, before any E1/E4 outcomes; its reason,
limits, preservation rules and conditional-model disclosure are recorded in
provenance/E0_conditional_mass_amendment_20261031.txt. Earlier protocol paragraphs
remain as the change history; this paragraph defines the final E1 admission.

2026-10-31 pre-E4 supplementary baseline extension: retain all main P0/PK/U
analyses, additionally transfer three parameter-free E1 rules to E4 single-round
outcomes using only local baseline/pair readouts. Selection of a single best
rule uses E1 within-item R2 only, never E4 outcomes. See
provenance/E4_pairwise_rule_supplement_pre_E4_20261031.txt. These additional CPU
analyses require no new model scores and do not alter main estimands.
